items.title: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico
items.summary: The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren't live, according to Politico.

items.title: Global banks commit $270M to stablecoin venture targeting 2027 launch
items.summary: Project Faro, backed by Goldman Sachs, Citigroup and BBVA, has secured $270 million in funding to launch a US dollar stablecoin in the first half of 2027.

items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements?
items.summary: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.

items.title: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets
items.summary: The protocol is investigating a potential security incident affecting its domain, while several users have reported losing funds after interacting with the platform.

items.title: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain's 'general purpose era'
items.summary: Ava Labs' John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.

items.title: Bitcoin Miner HIVE Eyes $45 Million in Annual Revenue From AI Deal
items.summary: The Bitcoin miner says its Boden facility could generate $45 million annually, but a June letter of intent remains nonbinding as executives negotiate financing and customer protections for the project

items.title: Trump Media Posts $410 Million Profit. Bitcoin Gains Did the Heavy Lifting
items.summary: Truth Social's parent booked $409.7 million in quarterly income largely from crypto investments, even as its stock remained more than 94% below its March 2024 peak.

items.title: Nvidia Erases 2026 Gains as Republicans Threaten Jensen Huang With Subpoena
items.summary: The chipmaker has erased its 2026 gains as a suspected Chinese espionage case brings fresh scrutiny of CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Near AI Breach Exposes User Details and Data From 18 AI Agents
items.summary: An SGLang flaw let an attacker reach internal systems and potentially view confidential AI requests, exposing the limits of hardware-backed privacy protections.

items.title: Elon Musk Calls Claude Opus 5.5 a 'Masterpiece', Admits Grok 4.8 Won't Match It
items.summary: Elon Musk says the incoming Grok 4.8 will trail Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5, praising his rival's model while predicting Grok 5 could surpass it in two or three months.

items.title: Grayscale Bets $1 Million on Zcash as Privacy Coin Tumbles
items.summary: Grayscale plans to direct $1 million from its Zcash ETF fees to ecosystem nonprofits and launched a national ad campaign, as ZEC fell more than 11%.

items.title: Forward Industries grows SOL treasury to 8.7 million as token hits nearly three-month low
items.summary: Forward adds a $50 million credit line and housing-linked investment to support further SOL accumulation.

items.title: Bitcoin slides below $74,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI as analysts warn of drop to $70k
items.summary: BTC slipped under $74,000 after October CPI beat forecasts. Analysts flag $73,000 support and a possible drop toward $69,000.

items.title: Grayscale pledges $1 million alongside Zcash ad blitz as token and ETF fall 12%
items.summary: Grayscale's Zcash push comes as its ETF faces continued withdrawals, extending October's net outflows.

items.title: TON Strategy earns $13.1 million from GRAM staking in Q3 as Telegram rolls out native wallet
items.summary: TON Strategy reported $13.1M in Q3 revenue, mostly from GRAM staking, and a $24M net loss as Telegram rolled out its native Gram Wallet.

items.title: Alta raises $47.5 million Series A to build a blockchain for financial institutions
items.summary: Alta's blockchain will combine privacy and compliance controls for banks and other financial firms.

items.title: Canaan's Q3 revenue plunges 90% to $14.5 million as bitcoin mining hardware sales slump
items.summary: Canaan's Q3 revenue fell 90% to $14.5 million, though cryptocurrency and derivatives gains supported an $8 million profit.
